candidates.name: RotoCo Roto-Rooter California
candidates.description: RotoCo is building the best plumbing team in the country. We’re not trying to do it all—we’re focused on doing one thing with excellence. Plumbing isn’t a bolt-on service or a side hustle. It’s who we are. It’s what we’ve mastered. And it’s what we’ve done day in and day out since 1935. As part of the Roto-Rooter network, we bring nearly a century of national trust into communities across California, from San Diego to Sacramento. But we’re not a platform or a patchwork. Each RotoCo branch is locally led and professionally run, backed by a culture that values precision, pride, and purpose. We don’t need gimmicks or noise. Our customers call us when they want it done right. And that only happens when we hire the right people, train them well, and give them room to grow. That’s why we invest in our team—because we’re not just building a company, we’re building careers. If you’re looking for a place where craftsmanship matters, where training and leadership are real, and where your work has impact, you’ll find it here. RotoCo. Plumbing is all we do. Plumbing is all we know. And we’re just getting started.
candidates.rationale: RotoCo appears to be a Roto-Rooter franchise/operator, not a separate lookalike company; it’s part of the seed network.

candidates.name: Classic Plumbing
candidates.description: When you need someone you can trust for your residential and commercial plumbing needs in the Plano area, you need Classic Plumbing. Serving the surrounding areas since 1986, we have proven time and again that we are the ones to call when you have any kind of plumbing needs. Whatever the plumbing problem, we can fix it. Our plumbers show up to your home with everything they need to fix most common plumbing problems on the spot. Even when your plumbing issues fall outside of common issues, we will generally have all of the parts and equipment needed to solve your plumbing problems in stock, saving you time and money. Whatever your plumbing needs are, Classic Plumbing handles them by getting the job done efficiently and at an honest price. Our services include: Plumbing repairs. Never too small…Never too large. We handle leaks, clogs, and all other plumbing issues. After we’ve done one job for you, you’ll know why Classic Plumbing is the only place to call for your plumbing needs. Plumbing replacement. When your plumbing is shot and you need new plumbing, you can count on us to give you a fair price for top quality workmanship. Whether you need pipes, toilets, or any other part of your plumbing system replaced, call Classic Plumbing. Plumbing remodeling. We do more than repairs. Classic Plumbing can update any old or broken pipes. When our experts do the job, you can count on a job done right, saving you headaches and expense down the road. Inspections and Certifications. Trust the professionals at Classic Plumbing for an honest assessment of any commercial or residential building’s plumbing. It pays to have any home or building inspected by Classic Plumbing . Emergency Services. We have plumbers on call at all hours, every day. We understand better than anyone that plumbing emergencies can become disasters if they aren’t tended to quickly. We are available 24 hours/day, 365 days/year to take care of your plumbing emergencies.
